report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Sampled traces show all checkout, order, inventory, payment, and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders (v1.0.0) and no 502s; deployment record shows only baseline 1.0.0 with no prior version. No current evidence establishes checkout errors or a deployment fault, so hand off for more data.
missing_evidence: Error/failed-span traces or logs showing checkout or order failures (all sampled traces returned 200)
Log evidence for the order service (excluded from context) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Deployment records for any version other than baseline 1.0.0, or evidence of a recent rollout
Metrics for the checkout/gateway service showing error rates, since order metrics show no 5xx
Dependency latency/error metrics for inventory, payment, and redis to rule out downstream causes
